company_name: Guangdong World Precision Technology Co., Ltd.
semiconductor_relevance: Medium — the company provides precision machining and assembly services that can support semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Guangdong World Precision Technology Co., Ltd. specializes in high-precision machining and assembly services, offering over 100 high-accuracy instruments and a substantial annual production capacity. Their capabilities include advanced surface finishing, vacuum heat-treatment, and high-volume assembly tailored for various industries, including semiconductor applications.
